The '''Saila Na system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
A malfunctioning [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Damaged Viper probe droid|Viper probe droid]] became stranded in the system some time during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], flying the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', [[Mission to the Saila Na system|engaged]] a number of scavengers from the ''[[Pelican]]'', who both wanted to claim it.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
